lobby.name: Lobby
lobby.description: The main-floor lobby, anchored by a flickering terminal that has been running since orientation and refuses to die. Hallways branch off in every direction; good luck keeping them straight.

interactables.guide: A guide to show you what required action to take in the current room

front_desk.name: Front Desk
front_desk.description: The front desk, where a receptionist greets you with the warm smile of someone who has fielded this same question seventeen times today. Register here; she insists.

interactables.guide: You can register a new profile by typing 'register <name>'

classroom_d2_015.name: Classroom D2 015
classroom_d2_015.description: A lecture hall its students fled, leaving loose papers scattered like a frustrated god of half-finished group projects. The projector may or may not be cursed.

teachers_room_1.name: Teachers Room 1
teachers_room_1.description: A teachers' office buried under filing cabinets, every drawer a tiny monument to paperwork. There is a desk here, and that desk is very, very locked.

desk.hint:
Keypad hint: 'Room number where intercultural collaboration class was help was held.
hint: D2084'

classroom_d2_035.name: Classroom D2 035
classroom_d2_035.description: A lab room with presentation workstations bolted so firmly to the tables that even the most determined student gave up. The screens still glow with last week's slides.

project_room_1.name: Project Room 1
project_room_1.description: A hardware testing bay that smells faintly of solder, ambition and regret. Yesterday's prototypes are taped together here under the patient hum of a power supply.

east_corridor.name: East Corridor
east_corridor.description: A long corridor that echoes like a cave and hums in one fluorescent monotone. The exit sign flickers in a way that is either reassuring or a warning - hard to say.

store.name: Store
store.description: The supply store - a parts cage ruled by a clerk with excellent posture and low tolerance for 'just borrowing'. Admire the stock, leave your spares at the deposit tray, touch nothing.

interactables.guide: A guide to show you what action to take in the current room

teachers_room_2.name: Teachers Room 2
teachers_room_2.description: An administrative office dominated by a whiteboard covered in a diagram only one long-retired person understood. It has stayed up 'for reference' for years now.

interactables.whiteboard: Written in red marker: 'Lab Network Pass: Tr0janH0rse!'

project_room_2.name: Project Room 2
project_room_2.description: A robotics testing arena where component crates wait like sleepy gladiators, and the floor wears the scuffs of a hundred robots that briefly believed in themselves.

teachers_room_4.name: Teacher Room 4
teachers_room_4.description: The senior faculty office, where the papers on the desk are arranged for maximum scholarly authority and minimum actual filing. A NixOS machine in the corner has clearly seen things.

interactables.guide:
On the note it says 'Explore the computer file system to see if you find anything interesting.
hint: its super secret'

lab_d2_001.name: Lab D 2001
lab_d2_001.description: Lab D 2001 - server room and the beating mechanical heart of the whole operation. The maze-server hums in its rack, waiting for someone to make it usable. That someone is you.

interactables.guide: A heavy metal table connected to a main server terminal.
interactables.server: A heavy metal table connected to a main server terminal.

lab_d2_002.name: Lab D2 002
lab_d2_002.description: Lab D2 002 - the assembly lab, built around an industrial workbench with a storied past. Feed it every part it asks for and it may just cough up a robot.

interactables.workbench: A heavy metal table connected to a main server terminal.

secret_key.name: Super secret Key
secret_key.description: Encrypted schematic detailing the 8 requisite hardware modules needed to assemble the A-maze-ing-Delft prototype.

development_board.name: ESP32 Development Board
development_board.description: Programmable computer designed to read inputs (like a button press or a temperature sensor) and control outputs

oled_display.name: O.96 Inch OLED Display
oled_display.description: A tiny, ultra-sharp monochrome screen. Requires no backlight because every individual pixel emits its own light

obstacle_avoidance_module.name: Obstacle Avoidance Module
obstacle_avoidance_module.description: A simple proximity sensor used to detect when an object is right in front of it

830_points_breadboard.name: 830 The-Points Breadboard
830_points_breadboard.description: a reusable prototyping board that lets you connect your ESP32, 0.96" OLED display, and obstacle sensor together without any soldering

f_m_dupont_cable.name: F-M (Female-to-Male) DuPont Cable
f_m_dupont_cable.description: A flexible jumper wire with a hollow socket (Female) on one end and a solid metal pin (Male) on the other

keycard_lvl1.name: Level-1 Staff Keycard
keycard_lvl1.description: A magnetic keycard. Opens restricted project and staff rooms.

hc_sr501_pir_motion_sensor.name: HC-SR501 PIR (Passive Infrared) Motion Sensor
hc_sr501_pir_motion_sensor.description: Watches for sudden changes in body heat (infrared radiation) moving across a room up to 7 meters (23 feet) away

micro_usb_cable.name: Micro-USB Cable
micro_usb_cable.description: The lifeline between your computer and most standard ESP32 development board

resistor_220r_1k_10k.name: Resistor-220R/1k/10k
resistor_220r_1k_10k.description: Passive electronic components that control and limit the flow of electrical current in your circuit

passive_buzzer.name: Passive Buzzer
passive_buzzer.description: A cylindrical electronic speaker that lets your ESP32 play musical notes, melodies, and multi-tone sound effects

active_buzzer.name: Active Buzzer
active_buzzer.description: A self-contained electronic sounder that produces a loud, continuous fixed-frequency beep

f_f_dupont_cable.name: F-F (Female-to-Female) DuPont Cable
f_f_dupont_cable.description: A jumper wire with hollow rectangular sockets (Female) on both ends

button_switch.name: Button Switch
button_switch.description: A momentary mechanical switch that sends a digital signal to your ESP32 only while you are physically pressing it down

10k_potentiometer.name: Potentiometer (10K)
10k_potentiometer.description: A rotary dial, that acts as an adjustable voltage divider.

red_led.name: Red Light Emitting Diode
red_led.description: A tiny solid-state light bulb that glows red when electrical current flows through it

yellow_led.name: Yellow Light Emitting Diode
yellow_led.description: A tiny solid-state light bulb that glows yellow when electrical current flows through it

green_led.name: Green Light Emitting Diode
green_led.description: A tiny solid-state light bulb that glows green when electrical current flows through it

m_m_dupont_cable.name: M-M (Male-to-Male) DuPont Cable
m_m_dupont_cable.description: a flexible jumper wire with solid metal pins (Male) on both ends

server_provisioning_certificate.name: Server Provisioning Certificate
server_provisioning_certificate.description: Cryptographic proof that the maze-server backend was correctly provisioned and hardened. Authorises the robot's neural link.
